065/**
066 * TNEStorageProvider
067 *
068 * @author creatorfromhell
069 * @since 0.1.2.0
070 */
071public class TNEStorageProvider implements StorageProvider {
072
073  private StorageEngine engine;
074  private StorageConnector<?> connector;
075
076  @Override
077  public void initialize(final String engine) {
078
079    final String prefix = DataConfig.yaml().getString("Data.Database.Prefix");
080    configureEngine(engine, prefix, mariaDriverAvailable());
081    registerDatables();
082  }
083
084  private boolean mariaDriverAvailable() {
085
086    boolean maria = false;
087    try {
088      Class.forName("org.mariadb.jdbc.Driver");
089      maria = true;
090    } catch(final Exception ignore) { }
091
092    try {
093      Class.forName("org.mariadb.jdbc.MariaDbDataSource");
094      maria = true;
095    } catch(final Exception ignore) { }
096    return maria;
097  }
098
099  private void configureEngine(final String engine, final String prefix, final boolean maria) {
100
101    switch(engine.toLowerCase()) {
102      case "mysql" -> configureMySql(prefix, maria);
103      case "maria", "mariadb" -> configureMaria(prefix, maria);
104      case "maria-outdated" -> configureOutdatedMaria(prefix, maria);
105      case "postgre" -> {
106        this.engine = new PostgreSQL(new MySQLDialect(prefix));
107        this.connector = new SQLConnector();
108      }
109      case "mysql-revamp" -> configureRevampedMySql(prefix, maria);
110      default -> {
111        this.engine = new YAML();
112        this.connector = new YAMLConnector();
113      }
114    }
115  }
116
117  private void configureMySql(final String prefix, final boolean maria) {
118
119    this.engine = maria? new MariaDB(prefix, new MariaDialect(prefix))
120                       : new MySQL(prefix, new MySQLDialect(prefix));
121    this.connector = new SQLConnector();
122  }
123
124  private void configureMaria(final String prefix, final boolean maria) {
125
126    this.engine = maria? new MariaDB(prefix, new MariaDialect(prefix))
127                       : new MySQL(prefix, new MariaDialect(prefix));
128    this.connector = new SQLConnector();
129  }
130
131  private void configureOutdatedMaria(final String prefix, final boolean maria) {
132
133    PluginCore.log().warning("Using outdated database! Please note: Official Support for this version of TNE is limited.", DebugLevel.OFF);
134    this.engine = maria? new MariaDB(prefix, new MariaOutdatedDialect(prefix))
135                       : new MySQL(prefix, new MariaOutdatedDialect(prefix));
136    this.connector = new SQLConnector();
137  }
138
139  private void configureRevampedMySql(final String prefix, final boolean maria) {
140
141    this.engine = maria? new MariaDB(prefix, new MySQLRevampDialect(prefix))
142                       : new MySQL(prefix, new MySQLRevampDialect(prefix));
143    this.connector = new SQLConnector();
144  }
145
146  private void registerDatables() {
147
148    final Datable<Account> account = (this.engine instanceof StandardSQL)? new SQLAccount() : new YAMLAccount();
149    final Datable<HoldingsEntry> entry = (this.engine instanceof StandardSQL)? new SQLHoldings() : new YAMLHoldings();
150    final Datable<Receipt> receipt = (this.engine instanceof StandardSQL)? new SQLReceipt() : new YAMLReceipt();
151
152    this.engine.datables().put(Account.class, account);
153    this.engine.datables().put(NonPlayerAccount.class, account);
154    this.engine.datables().put(SharedAccount.class, account);
155    this.engine.datables().put(GeyserAccount.class, account);
156    this.engine.datables().put(PlayerAccount.class, account);
157
158    this.engine.datables().put(HoldingsEntry.class, entry);
159    this.engine.datables().put(Receipt.class, receipt);
160  }
161
162  @Override
163  public StorageConnector<?> connector() {
164
165    return this.connector;
166  }
167
168  @Override
169  public StorageEngine engine() {
170
171    return this.engine;
172  }
173
174  @Override
175  public void initialize() {
176
177    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql
178       && this.engine instanceof final StandardSQL sqlEngine
179       && sqlEngine.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tneDialect) {
180
181      sql.executeUpdate(tneDialect.accountsTable(), new Object[]{});
182      sql.executeUpdate(tneDialect.accountsNonPlayerTable(), new Object[]{});
183      sql.executeUpdate(tneDialect.accountsPlayerTable(), new Object[]{});
184      sql.executeUpdate(tneDialect.accountMembersTable(), new Object[]{});
185      sql.executeUpdate(tneDialect.holdingsTable(), new Object[]{});
186      sql.executeUpdate(tneDialect.receiptsTable(), new Object[]{});
187      sql.executeUpdate(tneDialect.receiptsHoldingsTable(), new Object[]{});
188      sql.executeUpdate(tneDialect.receiptsParticipantsTable(), new Object[]{});
189      sql.executeUpdate(tneDialect.receiptsModifiersTable(), new Object[]{});
190
191      if(!(this.engine instanceof PostgreSQL) && !(tneDialect instanceof MySQLRevampDialect)) {
192        migrateReceiptKeys(sql, DataConfig.yaml().getString("Data.Database.Prefix"));
193      }
194    }
195  }
196
197  /**
198   * Receipt tables used to be keyed on the receipt id alone, so only the first participant,
199   * modifier and holdings row of each receipt was stored. This widens those keys on existing
200   * databases; it does nothing once they are widened.
201   */
202  private void migrateReceiptKeys(final SQLConnector sql, final String prefix) {
203
204    try(final Connection connection = sql.connection();
205        final Statement statement = connection.createStatement()) {
206
207      for(final String table : List.of(prefix + "receipts_participants", prefix + "receipts_modifiers")) {
208        if(primaryKeyColumns(connection, table) == 1) {
209          statement.executeUpdate("ALTER TABLE " + table + " DROP PRIMARY KEY, ADD PRIMARY KEY(uid, participant_type)");
210          PluginCore.log().inform("Widened primary key of " + table + ".");
211        }
212      }
213
214      final String holdings = prefix + "receipts_holdings";
215      for(final String index : uidOnlyUniqueIndexes(connection, holdings)) {
216        statement.executeUpdate("ALTER TABLE " + holdings + " DROP INDEX `" + index + "`, ADD UNIQUE KEY "
217                                + "receipt_holding (uid, participant, ending, region, currency, holdings_type)");
218        PluginCore.log().inform("Widened unique key of " + holdings + ".");
219      }
220    } catch(final SQLException e) {
221      PluginCore.log().error("Failed to update receipt table keys; transaction history stays incomplete.",
222                             e, DebugLevel.OFF);
223    }
224  }
225
226  private int primaryKeyColumns(final Connection connection, final String table) throws SQLException {
227
228    int columns = 0;
229    try(final ResultSet keys = connection.getMetaData().getPrimaryKeys(connection.getCatalog(), null, table)) {
230      while(keys.next()) {
231        columns++;
232      }
233    }
234    return columns;
235  }
236
237  private List<String> uidOnlyUniqueIndexes(final Connection connection, final String table) throws SQLException {
238
239    final Map<String, List<String>> indexes = new HashMap<>();
240    try(final ResultSet info = connection.getMetaData().getIndexInfo(connection.getCatalog(), null, table, true, false)) {
241      while(info.next()) {
242        final String name = info.getString("INDEX_NAME");
243        if(name != null && !"PRIMARY".equalsIgnoreCase(name)) {
244          indexes.computeIfAbsent(name, ignored->new ArrayList<>()).add(info.getString("COLUMN_NAME"));
245        }
246      }
247    }
248    return indexes.entrySet().stream()
249            .filter(entry->entry.getValue().equals(List.of("uid")))
250            .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
251            .toList();
252  }
253
254  @Override
255  public void storeAll(@NotNull final String identifier) {
256
257    final Optional<Datable<?>> data = Optional.ofNullable(engine.datables().get(HoldingsEntry.class));
258
259    //Our account storeAll requires no identifier, so we set it to null
260    data.ifPresent(datable->datable.storeAll(connector, identifier));
261  }
262
263  @Override
264  public void storeAll() {
265
266    TNECore.instance().saver().saveAll();
267  }
268
269  @Override
270  public void delete(@NotNull final String identifier) {
271
272
273    final Optional<Datable<?>> data = Optional.ofNullable(engine.datables().get(Account.class));
274
275    //Our account storeAll requires no identifier, so we set it to null
276    data.ifPresent(datable->TNECore.instance().saver().run(()->datable.delete(connector, identifier)));
277
278  }

289  }
